deha_dasha_guide.description: Deha Dasha (Level 6) -- finest subdivision of Vimshottari, 20 min to 14 hours. 'Deha' means body -- effects manifest primarily through physical sensations, somatic shifts, and brief energetic impulses. Per BPHS, the Deha lord colors the body's element balance for its brief duration. At this level, planetary influence is felt as fleeting physical micro-states rather than events or sustained moods.

sun.theme: Brief vitality surge, authority impulse, pitta flash
sun.body_focus: Heart, eyes, head -- brief heat activation, pulse quickens, forehead warmth
micro_advice: Use for confident decisions requiring assertiveness
Avoid ego clashes and heated arguments
Drink cool water if body heat spikes
sun.avoid: Overexertion in heat, staring at screens, confrontation with authority figures

moon.theme: Emotional micro-wave, fluid shift, comfort craving
moon.body_focus: Stomach, chest, lymph -- brief water retention, appetite shift, sinus awareness
micro_advice: Honor the comfort need briefly -- warm drink, soft music
Note any intuitive flash; it carries accuracy at this level
Avoid cold foods if body feels heavy
moon.avoid: Emotional decisions, dairy overload, exposure to cold drafts

mars.theme: Adrenaline micro-burst, muscle tension, action urge
mars.body_focus: Muscles, blood, adrenals -- brief heat in limbs, restless hands, jaw tension
micro_advice: Channel into brief physical movement -- walk, stretch, push-ups
Handle one task requiring courage or confrontation
Be cautious with sharp objects and hot surfaces
mars.avoid: Reckless driving, arguments, handling fire or blades carelessly

mercury.theme: Mental flicker, verbal impulse, nervous tingle
mercury.body_focus: Nervous system, hands, skin -- finger restlessness, throat dryness, skin tingle
micro_advice: Send the important message or make the quick call now
Jot down any idea that flashes -- it fades fast at Deha level
Take a screen break if eyes feel strained
mercury.avoid: Verbal overcommitment, signing documents impulsively, caffeine excess

jupiter.theme: Warm expansiveness, brief optimism, appetite rise
jupiter.body_focus: Liver, fat tissue, thighs -- warmth in abdomen, hunger spike, sense of ease
micro_advice: Use the brief optimism for a decision you have been delaying
Eat mindfully -- appetite rises but digestion may not match
A brief prayer or gratitude moment amplifies the sattvic window
jupiter.avoid: Overeating rich food, overcommitting from momentary optimism

venus.theme: Sensory pleasure flash, skin softening, social warmth
venus.body_focus: Reproductive system, kidneys, skin -- brief glow, sweet craving, throat softness
micro_advice: Appreciate something beautiful -- music, art, nature -- for grounding
Good micro-window for a kind word to partner or friend
Moisturize skin; body absorbs nourishment well now
venus.avoid: Impulsive luxury purchases, sugar binge, romantic decisions based on fleeting attraction

saturn.theme: Brief heaviness, joint stiffness, duty awareness
saturn.body_focus: Joints, bones, lower back -- fleeting stiffness, cold hands, dryness in knees
micro_advice: Stretch or apply warm oil to stiff joints
Complete one small pending duty -- clearing it lifts the heaviness
Drink warm water; avoid cold beverages
saturn.avoid: Starting new ventures, cold exposure, forcing energy when body asks to slow down

rahu.theme: Restless craving, sensory confusion, brief disorientation
rahu.body_focus: Nervous system, stomach, skin -- unexplained itch, gurgling stomach, brief dizziness
micro_advice: Ground yourself -- feet on floor, deep breaths, touch something solid
Do not trust a sudden intense craving; it passes in minutes
Check information twice if making any quick decisions
rahu.avoid: Intoxicants, impulsive online purchases, trusting unverified information

ketu.theme: Momentary detachment, body numbness, spiritual micro-flash
ketu.body_focus: Spine, pineal area, extremities -- brief tingling, numbness in fingers, spacey feeling
micro_advice: If meditation calls, even 5 minutes yields disproportionate depth
Let go of one thing you are holding onto -- the release is effortless now
Eat warm grounding food if feeling spacey
ketu.avoid: Driving when feeling spacey, starting new material projects, forcing focus on worldly tasks
